title: Aaron's Staff Buds

questions.question: How many staffs were collected?
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:2 (ESV): "Take... twelve staffs, one for each fathers' house."

questions.question: What name was written on the staff of Levi?
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:3 (ESV): "And write Aaron's name on the staff of Levi."

questions.question: What happened to Aaron's staff the next day?
options: It sprouted, put forth buds, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds
questions.correctAnswer: It sprouted, put forth buds, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:8 (ESV): "...the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted and put forth buds and produced blossoms, and it bore ripe almonds."

questions.question: Where was Aaron's staff to be kept?
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:10 (ESV): "Put back the staff of Aaron before the testimony..."

questions.question: Why was the staff kept?
options: To be kept as a sign for the rebels
To use as a walking stick
questions.correctAnswer: To be kept as a sign for the rebels
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:10 (ESV): "...to be kept as a sign for the rebels, that you may make an end of their grumblings..."

questions.question: How did the people react after this sign?
options: They cried out in fear of dying
questions.correctAnswer: They cried out in fear of dying
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:12-13 (ESV): "Behold, we perish, we are undone... Everyone who comes near... dies."

questions.question: What fruit did the staff bear?
For whom were the staffs taken?
options: For the head of each fathers' house
questions.correctAnswer: For the head of each fathers' house
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:3 (ESV): "For there shall be one staff for the head of each fathers' house."

questions.question: Where were the staffs placed overnight?
options: In the tent of meeting before the testimony
questions.correctAnswer: In the tent of meeting before the testimony
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:4 (ESV): "And you shall deposit them in the tent of meeting before the testimony..."

questions.question: The purpose of the sign was to stop what?
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:5 (ESV): "And I will make to cease from me the grumblings of the people of Israel..."

questions.question: "The man whom I choose, his staff shall...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:5 (ESV): "...the staff of the man whom I choose shall sprout."

questions.question: The people said, "Are we all to...?"
Did Moses check the staffs alone?
options: He brought them out to all the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He brought them out to all the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:9 (ESV): "Then Moses brought out all the staffs... to all the people of Israel."

questions.question: What day did Moses go into the tent of the testimony to check?
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:8 (ESV): "On the next day Moses went into the tent..."

questions.question: What did the people see regarding the other staffs?
options: They looked and each man took his staff
questions.correctAnswer: They looked and each man took his staff
questions.explanation: Numbers 17:9 (ESV): "And they looked, and each man took his staff."

key_verse_text: On the next day Moses went into the tent of the testimony, and behold, the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted and put forth buds and produced blossoms, and it bore ripe almonds.
